Crust+topping slice total: a pizza slice of this size is typically around 70-90 g, so I estimate the whole slice at about 75 g. Splitting that by component: crust ~40 g, cheese ~12 g, meat ~13 g, tomato sauce ~10 g.

- Cheese (mozzarella-type): ~280 kcal/100 g → 12 g ≈ 34 kcal
- Ham/pepperoni-style meat: ~300 kcal/100 g → 13 g ≈ 39 kcal

Total ≈ 75 g, ≈ 184 kcal.
